elements.label: Notion AI face features (brows, eyes, nose)

pattern.description: Inside the static Notion AI face badge, the line-drawn features redraw from a side-glance expression (one dot eye, flat brow) to a frontal look with two arched brows and two eyes, like the mascot turning to face the viewer.
pattern.why_premium: A few frames of stroke morphing give the brand mascot personality and a 'looking at you' moment while the badge itself stays perfectly still, so the change reads clearly.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to(featurePaths, {morphSVG: frontalExpression, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); eye dots: gsap.to(eyes, {x: dx, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); badge untouched. Without MorphSVG, swap expression SVGs on a 2-3 frame crossfade.
build_hint.remotion: const p = interpolate(frame, [0, 6], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); interpolate SVG path points (flubber-style) or crossfade two expression layers by p. Ease, not spring.

notes: Only b01 (features) changes; the circle badge and blue background are static (camera move none). No SFX candidates in the packet, though the spectrogram shows a short transient near 2.07 s inside the event window.
